description: 한국에너지공단_1km급 해상도 중심점 위치정보 및 풍력이용률 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국에너지공단. 본 데이터는 국내 해상(바다)을 1km 격자 단위로 나누어 각 격자 중심점의 정확한 위치 정보와 해당 지역의 풍력이용률을 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국에너지공단. Its tags are 풍력, 이용률, 지도, 해상, 풍력발전기. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
